authorization: User requested Class-style hardening for skills/abilities, upgrades and Talent Web; preserve unrelated rules and existing campaigns.

rulebook-v1.0.txt.text:
## V1.0 Skill & Ability Originality Firewall — all acquisition tracks

This is the mandatory ability-level companion to Section 8's Class Novelty Firewall. Apply it to new Class-kit powers, starting and later Signatures, Title powers, Background Imprints, Skill Point Evolutions, new Talent Web offers and eligible keystones, Class Breakthroughs, Grand Signatures, and genuinely earned summon/item-granted abilities. It governs DESIGN QUALITY, not extra acquisitions or rolls. Mundane attacks, routine equipment and already-owned abilities do not need to become exotic new systems.

### Design the mechanic first; roll only the actual finalists

For a new five-offer power or advancement board, privately sketch approximately 12–15 BRIEF, mechanically different seeds, then select the required five eligible finalists before their eligible rarity/Luck rolls. A seed is a one-line operation, not a fully written card. Reuse the existing Class or Background sketch pass for powers belonging to that same generation step; do not multiply it into a separate 15-seed exercise for every button. Develop complete mechanics and cinematic descriptions only for the real offers. All screening happens privately in the normal generation turn, with no added player decisions, menu clicks, tool-confirmation loops or public draft boards.

A fixed-grade Hybrid Breakthrough board still has precisely three Class Breakthroughs and two Grand Signatures, exactly one Background-synergy Class Breakthrough, and NO new milestone rarity/Luck rolls. Independently rolled tracks keep their original independent rolls and selection counts. Seeds never receive candidate rolls. After a legitimate rarity is fixed, certify or repair the concept at that SAME rarity; do not discard a disappointing roll, make a hidden replacement roll, or inflate a Common result into a disguised UNIQUE.

For a single earned power or a newly eligible keystone, compare a few brief distinct legal directions rather than fabricating five rewards. Predefined purchased Talent/Skill Stage improvements retain their original recorded progression; this gate does not regenerate an already-defined upgrade, reroll its rarity or add a new entitlement.

### Mechanical fingerprints, not renamed filler

For each finalist record concise design facts: actual owned source if any; primary legal verb and the object/state it changes; activation or inherited trigger; targeting/geometry; resource interaction; tactical or noncombat decision it opens; material limitation/counterplay; and its nearest potential duplicate. Compare these facts against the other offers, the ACTUAL owned kit and available retained offers. Names, damage types, particles, conditions, slightly different dice and modified meter values do not establish different mechanisms by themselves.

Perform the stripped-name test: if another offer or recent power still produces substantially the same decisions after its name, element and visuals are removed, redesign it BEFORE its normal rolls. A new trigger attached to the same payload is not automatically a new concept. Five-offer boards must provide at least three materially different decision patterns or useful play directions, even if several modify the same eligible parent. Do not force a quota of attacks, Reactions, passives, summons or support powers into every board.

**Repeated-filler veto:** Do not habitually populate boards with "Reaction: when hit, reduce damage by 1d6", "you or a summon move another 2 meters if X", minor temporary HP, a small accuracy rider, a negligible cooldown reduction or equivalent cosmetic variants. At most ONE offer on a board may derive its main identity from generic incoming-damage subtraction, and at most ONE from a small conditional movement-distance bonus. This is a ceiling on filler, not a requirement to include either. Merely changing the trigger, target, die, range, element or ability name does not evade that ceiling. Genuinely different defensive or traversal mechanisms can coexist when they change actual choices rather than repeat that payload.

These families are NOT permanently banned. A direct, reliable numerical improvement can be a good Common/Uncommon offer, a recorded Stage benefit or an explicitly requested simple specialization when it fills a real role. State its practical value and honor its actual rarity. Do not turn every low-rarity result into an elaborate minigame, and do not present an incidental minor rider as the entire identity of a supposedly exceptional power. Apply Section 5's actual tier contract: EPIC, LEGENDARY and UNIQUE need consequential qualitative capability at their promised scale; UNIQUE is not synonymous with bigger dice or more bookkeeping.

### A usable new decision must exist now

Privately test each offer in one ordinary encounter or relevant noncombat situation at the character's CURRENT level, resource pool, legal sources and action economy. Identify what the player can now accomplish, choose, combine or prevent that the unmodified kit could not already do as effectively. A different prose description of an unchanged result fails. A benefit that matters only against a contrived enemy, imaginary ally, unowned summon, future Talent or removed form fails an immediately eligible board.

Require useful trigger frequency and a meaningful choice or reliable new affordance without demanding a bespoke mini-resource for every offer. Cost, legal targets, hit/miss/save outcomes, duration, stacking, competing Reactions/Free Actions and failure cases must support the advertised function. Cinematic manifestation must describe these SAME mechanics; exciting fiction cannot smuggle in additional effects. Novelty is compatible with clear, short cards and powerful straightforward play. Do not weaken a genuinely strong class or give ordinary enemies convenient immunities to make a new skill appear necessary.

### Track-specific identity and boundaries

- **Class powers and Signatures:** Connect to the actual class law or deliberately complementary role. Check the complete normal-turn loop and mutually exclusive forms/summons. Do not repeat a generic attack/mitigation/dash trio across unrelated classes or make a solo class depend on an assumed party. A class-native power and an independently acquired Signature remain distinct sources.
- **Skill Evolutions:** Show the exact parent and a before/after statement of its changed operation. Explore substantively different integrated interactions with the parent's targeting, consequences, space, information, resource logic or existing limitations instead of a parade of small stat increases. This is NOT a menu of prescribed effects. Every evolution remains an INTEGRATED PASSIVE inside the parent's existing activation/trigger, with no separate button, new Action/Free Action/Reaction, independent cost, charge pool or cooldown. Stage gates, purchased branches and original source rarity remain intact. An upgrade to an existing Reaction does not grant another Reaction.
- **Talent Web:** Make OPEN offers useful without a mandatory purchase chain. SYNERGY paths should support genuinely different voluntary playstyles through actually owned mechanics, not five nodes of the same bonus or a tax required to make the class function. An eligible KEYSTONE should pay off its real path through a distinctive bounded interaction, not rename the sum of its prerequisites; it is still independently rolled, separately purchased and additional to the five standard eligible offers. Existing Stage progression, point costs and exclusions stay separate. Owning synergistic names grants no free third power.
- **Class Breakthroughs and Grand Signatures:** Compare against recent ordinary Talent and Skill Evolution boards as well as the current kit. A milestone must open a breakthrough-scale class operation or structural development, not repackage a modest Talent, numerically larger ordinary attack or minor evolution. Preserve the fixed class-grade 3+2 structure and the sole Background-synergy slot.
- **Titles and Background Imprints:** Give each new offer a distinct actual identity interaction. An Imprint changes ONE truly owned Class/selected Signature/selected Title parent through that parent's existing activation; it cannot become an extra skill, Reaction or second source. Title NONE remains ineligible as a parent. A Title must not invent prior achievements, and a World Footprint must not secretly grant another combat power.
- **Summon and item-granted powers:** Distinguish actual bodies, behavior, command permissions, formation/spatial interaction, useful roles and limits where those sources exist. Do not default every summon to a tank/scout pair, a tiny move rider, a generic shared damage shield or a reskinned copy of the same creature. Preserve autonomous behavior, real ownership, source costs and bounded action/command budgets. Do not inject summons or unearned gear into a class simply to satisfy variety.

### Cross-campaign variety and honest continuity

Retain a compact novelty ledger of actually generated/revealed offers: source/track, mechanical fingerprint, final rarity, acquired/archived status and recent overused families. Compare new candidates with genuinely accessible authorized prior-generation records as well as the current board. Vary recurring operations, economy and decisions, not only names. Familiar themes can recur when their actual operation is materially different; do not use permanent theme bans to make a coherent build impossible.

Use only records that really exist and are available. Do not invent memories of past campaigns, scan unrelated private chats, import a paused campaign, or claim global history coverage from one current conversation. Missing history limits the comparison; the intrinsic anti-template and within-build checks still apply. Store compact design facts rather than regenerating the whole history or producing unsolicited downloadable saves. Updating this rulebook never rewrites an existing acquired power, archived offer, rolled result or campaign. Correct already-revealed mechanics only with the player's explicit approval.

Before showing the finished board, privately verify distinct mechanisms, ordinary-use value, actual-source compatibility, correct acquisition track and rarity strength. Fix failed concepts before the first reveal. The player sees concise usable choices with expandable exact mechanics, not a creativity-audit questionnaire. Never claim that a naming change, a saved fingerprint, a Python roll or a passed text-integrity test proves semantic originality; the finished mechanical offers must actually pass the comparison.

rulebook-v1.0.txt.text: Apply Section 9's V1.0 Skill & Ability Originality Firewall at breakthrough scale. Private concept screening adds no milestone rarity/Luck roll, extra reward, extra choice or Background-synergy slot; the fixed-grade three-Class-Breakthrough/two-Grand-Signature structure below remains binding.

Apply Section 9's V1.0 Skill & Ability Originality Firewall to new open/synergy offers and newly eligible keystones. Compare actual play directions rather than renamed small bonuses; preserve immediately eligible standard offers, independent eligible rarity rolls, voluntary paths, separate Stage costs and every archive/ownership restriction below.

rule-hardener.txt.text:
## 3A. Skill, upgrade and Talent originality — mandatory first-board gate

Apply the rulebook's Section 9 Skill & Ability Originality Firewall to all new Class powers, Signatures, Title effects, Background Imprints, integrated Skill Evolutions, Talent Web offers/eligible keystones, Hybrid Breakthroughs/Grand Signatures, and real earned summon/item-granted powers. The Class firewall is not the only system entitled to first-pass creativity.

For a five-offer board, privately sketch approximately 12–15 SHORT mechanical seeds, select the required five legal distinct finalists before eligible rarity rolls, and fully elaborate only those finalists. Reuse the same Class/Background design pass where applicable. No extra player turn, draft approval, extra reward, candidate roll or per-option confirmation is added. Fixed-grade3+2 milestones remain fixed grade with no rarity/Luck roll. Single earned powers and predefined Stage improvements do not create extra boards.

Strip names, elements and visuals. Compare primary verb/state change, actual source, activation/trigger, targeting/geometry, economy, useful decision and limits against sibling offers, owned powers, retained offers and real accessible authorized history. Five renamed versions of the same effect fail. Require at least three genuinely different play directions on a five-offer board, without forcing action-type quotas.

**Veto habitual filler:** "Reaction: if hit, reduce damage by1d6" and "you/your summons move+2 meters if X" must not become the default reward vocabulary across campaigns. At most ONE main-identity generic damage-subtraction offer and ONE small conditional movement-distance offer per board; neither is mandatory. Different triggers, names, elements or larger dice do not defeat this check. Distinct defense/traversal laws may coexist. Simple Common/Uncommon numerical benefits remain valid when useful and nonredundant; exceptional rarities require the actual consequential qualitative capability promised by Section5.

Skill Evolutions and Imprints stay integrated inside their ONE real parent's normal activation/passive trigger: no new button, Action, Free Action, Reaction, independent payment, charge pool or cooldown. Talent Web open/synergy/keystone paths retain their own costs, stages, eligibility and voluntary specialization. A purchased combo is not a free third skill. Milestones stay breakthrough-scale, fixed source-class grade, exactly three Class Breakthroughs plus two Grand Signatures and exactly one Background-linked Class Breakthrough.

Test ordinary current-level usefulness, solo viability where appropriate, reachable triggers, competition for Reactions/Free Actions, honest tier strength, stacking and actual source compatibility. Avoid contrived conditions, hypothetical allies and incompatible summons/forms. Keep concise genuine mechanical fingerprints for future variety; use only history actually available and never import or alter paused play. Do not rewrite acquired or revealed powers without explicit permission. Fix failed concepts before first reveal, not after the player complains. These checks belong in the pre-response audit; they are not a claim that Python dice or a text validator can guarantee creativity.
